description: Rota Load Disconnection is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Please note, this dataset has now been archived indefinitely. If you would like to know your block letter, please visit: Find my block letter UK Power Cut? Call 105 For Free Find Your Electricity Provider This dataset shows the primary feeding areas with their assigned rota load disconnection codes. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2024-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
